rows.grounds: relative pronoun; antecedent not explicit in this verse
instrumental of means; mātra expresses mere sufficiency
action-noun compound denoting removal of inertia

items.question: What power does mere knowledge of this possess to remove dullness?
premises: A certain knowledge is referred to by the relative pronoun.
Mere apprehension of this knowledge is sufficient.
The removal of dullness is its potential effect.
items.inference: Therefore, mere knowledge of this can bring about the removal of dullness.
uncertainties: The antecedent of yasyā is not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: By merely knowing this, the removal of dullness may come about.
